verdict.rationale: The H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator, so operating it with natural-language commands is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence covers LLM inference running on the GPU (NIM, inference endpoints) but shows no natural-language control of the product itself, so nothing makes the axis apply.
